g.text: BankDash Credit Cards Management Interaction & Animation Locators
Visual mapping of 5 key interactive zones: multi-tier card slider, donut statistics & live card builder
3-Card Multi-Tier 3D Tilt Carousel
Smoke Mint, Forest Pine & Crisp White cards with 3D parallax tilt & chip sheen
TRIGGER: Mouse hover / Carousel drag & navigation
Donut Slice Pop-Out & Percentage Tickers
Donut slices pop outward with deep drop shadow, live legend sync & percentage readouts
TRIGGER: Hovering donut slices or legend keys
Card Specification Rows & Details Modal Launch
Horizontal card items with bank logo badges, formatted card numbers & View Details modal
TRIGGER: Hovering card item / Clicking View Details
Live 2×2 Form Validation + Real-Time Card Sync
Input fields with floating border glow, real-time card number formatting,
and instant interactive validation toast upon card creation
TRIGGER: Focus, typing in form / Clicking Add Card
Security Toggles, Pin Modal & Apple Pay Link
Interactive setting rows for Block Card, Pin Change, Apple Pay/Google Pay
with tactile switch micro-animations & modal verification dialogs
TRIGGER: Hovering settings / Clicking security action
KEY INTERACTIONS SUMMARY:
Cards: Multi-Tier Tilt
Donut: Slice Pop-Out
List: Details Modal
Form: Live Validation
Security: Toggles & Pin
All interactions use GPU hardware-accelerated transforms & zero-layout-shift (CLS = 0.00) with accessible aria controls.
